custom_field_defs_range.name: custom_field_defs_range
custom_field_defs_range.value: "custom_field_defs"."min_value" is null or "custom_field_defs"."max_value" is null or "custom_field_defs"."max_value" >= "custom_field_defs"."min_value"

custom_field_values_single.name: custom_field_values_single
custom_field_values_single.value: (case when "custom_field_values"."text_value" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "custom_field_values"."number_value" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "custom_field_values"."date_value" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "custom_field_values"."option_value" is not null then 1 else 0 end + case when "custom_field_values"."bool_value" is not null then 1 else 0 end) = 1

integration_destinations_one_target.name: integration_destinations_one_target
integration_destinations_one_target.value: ("integration_destinations"."team_id" is not null) <> ("integration_destinations"."project_id" is not null)

role_assignments_scope_matches.name: role_assignments_scope_matches
role_assignments_scope_matches.value:
("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'organization' and "role_assignments"."department_id" is null and "role_assignments"."team_id" is null and "role_assignments"."project_id" is null)
        or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' and "role_assignments"."department_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."team_id" is null and "role_assignments"."project_id" is null)
        or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'team' and "role_assignments"."team_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."department_id" is null and "role_assignments"."project_id" is null)
        or ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'project' and "role_assignments"."project_id" is not null and "role_assignments"."department_id" is null and "role_assignments"."team_id" is null)

roles_system_has_no_org.name: roles_system_has_no_org
roles_system_has_no_org.value: ("roles"."is_system" and "roles"."org_id" is null) or (not "roles"."is_system" and "roles"."org_id" is not null)

tasks_series_occurrence_uq.name: tasks_series_occurrence_uq
tasks_series_occurrence_uq.where: "tasks"."series_id" is not null and "tasks"."deleted_at" is null

tasks_date_range.name: tasks_date_range
tasks_date_range.value: "tasks"."start_date" is null or "tasks"."due_date" is null or "tasks"."due_date" >= "tasks"."start_date"
